Name: Pet Choice Perks
Author: Skuld
Description:
This mods adds some more use and consequence to the player's animal choice. The player will receive a permanent bonus for just owning a pet and a temporary buff for petting.

[b][size=4]Dog[/size][/b]

[b]Permanent bonus: [/b]All farm animals receive a small happiness bonus.
[b]Petting buff:[/b] +1 to foraging.

[size=4][b]Cat[/b][/size]

[b]Permanent bonus:[/b] No crows will spawn on the player's farm.
[b]Petting buff:[/b] +1 to fishing.

The petting buff is luck-dependant and its duration will vary.

[b][size=4]If you want more use for your pets still, check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2132]Cat Gifts mod[/url]![/size]

[size=4]Known conflicts[/size]
[/b]Probably and possibly any mod that uses Harmony, but especially Better Rarecrows, since that mod also removes Crow spawns.

[size=4][b]Thanks to[/b][/size]
Jason9896 for suggesting this mod
